nodes.name: AI Triage (OpenAI)

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "gpt-4o-mini", temperature: 0, response_format: { type: "json_object" }, messages: [ { role: "system", content: "You triage inbound service requests for a small residential HVAC company in South Florida.
Return ONLY a JSON object with these keys:
- urgency: "emergency" (gas/CO smell, no heat or no AC with a baby/elderly/medical need, active flooding), "urgent" (no heat, no cooling, water leak), or "routine" (tune-ups, quotes, noises, thermostat questions)
- jobType: one of no_heat, no_cooling, gas_or_co_safety, water_leak, noise_or_smell, thermostat, maintenance, install_quote, other
- language: "en" or "es" — the language the customer wrote in
- summary: one short line a technician can read in 3 seconds
- equipment: the equipment mentioned (e.g. "heat pump"), or null
- preferredTime: any timing the customer asked for, or null
- confidence: a number from 0 to 1" }, { role: "user", content: "Customer message:
" + $json.lead.message } ] }) }}

nodes.notes: Needs a Header Auth credential: Name = Authorization, Value = Bearer sk-... . No key? Deactivate this node and the workflow runs on the rules engine.

nodes.name: Log to CRM (Google Sheet)
nodes.notes: appendOrUpdate on lead_id = a double-submitted form updates the same row instead of making a duplicate.

nodes.name: Ping On-Call Tech (Slack/Discord)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ content: $('Time Window, Review & Reply Draft').item.json.tech_alert, text: $('Time Window, Review & Reply Draft').item.json.tech_alert }) }}

nodes.notes: A failed ping never blocks the lead. Paste a Discord or Slack incoming-webhook URL.

parameters.content:
## HVAC Lead Autopilot — by Gabriel Nadal
Web form / text → AI triage (urgency, job type, language) → validation + rules fallback + gas/CO safety guardrail → time window + human-review checks → bilingual reply DRAFT → Google Sheet mini-CRM (deduped by lead_id) → ping on-call tech for urgent jobs.
Reply drafts are never auto-sent: an office manager approves them.
